summary: Build and publish Nex Core/Controller 0.3.1 to the existing signed website APT archive and publish the exact ISO, corresponding sources, manifest and checksums to versioned/latest downloads. Record artifact verification and update publication status without closing feature acceptance gates.

guide.reason: Point release operators at current exact-artifact and direct website/APT publication evidence.

api.reason: Distribution artifacts, signed APT metadata and release evidence change no Controller/Core or client-facing request, result, authorization or durable operation.

roadmap.reason: Record publication of already implemented CPU work; no public milestone scope or feature acceptance state changes.

state.reason: Release outputs and APT indexes are distribution data, not pool or Controller-scoped runtime state.

verification.method: 93 focused release/source/package/APT tests, installer checks, exact artifact/source/notice verification and Controller package runtime smoke passed. Final ISO BIOS/KVM install, first boot/reboot and BIOS/KVM+UEFI/TCG menus passed. Existing remote publishers completed, latest points to 0.3.1, retained versions preserved, staging removed and website active. Full public ISO/source/manifest/package downloads matched local hashes and sizes; versioned/latest sidecars and manifest bindings passed. InRelease verified against published and shipped archive keys; its Packages hash, both package payload entries and updates.json agreed. Independent review and documentation/privacy/diff checks passed. No hosted CI, Git-forge publication or live-host upgrade claimed.
